load_consistency_decoder_vae: load a pretrained ConsistencyDecoderVAE model from the openai/consistency-decoder HuggingFace hub
encode_images_to_latents: encode a batch of images into latent representations using the ConsistencyDecoderVAE encoder
decode_latents_to_images: decode latent vectors back to images using the consistency decoder with configurable inference steps
tiled_encode_large_images: encode large images using tiled encoding to keep memory usage constant regardless of image size
run_full_vae_forward_pass: run a full encode-decode forward pass through the ConsistencyDecoderVAE model with optional posterior sampling
